title: vincetoxicum roylei
intro: Vincetoxicum roylei, commonly known as the Indian swallowwort, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to the Himalayan region. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Vincetoxicum roylei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
